title_working: Boeing Knew the 737 MAX Could Do This. The Pilots Were Never Told the System Existed.
risk_note: R3. Live corporate and legal exposure. The film must hold the record exactly as the ledger states it: the criminal case ended in DISMISSAL, not conviction (MX-308); Boeing admissions are BY AGREEMENT (MX-204); the single individual tried was ACQUITTED and is never named (MX-405); the jump-seat pilot did not save the previous flight (MX-708); the Ethiopian report is contested by the NTSB and the film says so (MX-805/806). No real person is depicted or named; every figure is anonymous. Real carrier trade dress is a standing hazard on this subject -- three plates and one stock clip carrying real liveries were blocked during production.
